assessment_evidence: The strict annual folds show descriptive OOS ranking information, but temporal/regime variation, weak tail evidence, cost sensitivity, and absence of an untouched holdout prevent a strong YES conclusion.
key_findings: Mean daily Rank IC is 0.0499; 20-session block-bootstrap 95% CI is [0.017311704609088104, 0.08686498031154578].
6/6 yearly folds have positive Rank IC; 2025 is 0.0012.
Rank IC confidence lower bound is above zero.
There is no untouched confirmatory holdout: all 2020–2025 folds were available during historical development, and 2026 is disqualified.
Residual Rank IC after sector/size/volatility/momentum/liquidity controls is 0.0205.
Ridge Rank IC is 0.0483; model complexity must earn its incremental value.
Daily Top20 retention is 70.3%; cost fragility is reported without execution claims.
The Q1→Q5 return curve is not monotonic: Q3 outperforms Q5, so ranking information is not cleanly calibrated.
Risk-off, technology, large-cap, and low-volatility slices are the principal weak regions.
Top20 is not uniquely supported: Top30/Top50 had stronger development net proxy alpha, but must not be selected on these reused folds.

recommendations.evidence: The frozen model was selected using 2020–2025 and 2026 is not untouched.
recommendations.experiment: Pre-register features, model, Top-K and gates, then collect prospective matured labels without retuning.
recommendations.hypothesis: Selection bias is the largest unresolved uncertainty.
recommendations.success: Positive Rank IC block-bootstrap lower bound and positive net proxy alpha across the pre-registered period.
recommendations.title: Create a genuinely untouched confirmation period

recommendations.evidence: Risk-off Rank IC is 0.0187 versus 0.0665 in neutral; technology is 0.0075 and 2025 is 0.00125.
recommendations.experiment: Develop PIT-safe regime interactions only on a new development partition.
recommendations.hypothesis: Gen2 failure is concentrated rather than uniform.
recommendations.success: Worst-regime Rank IC improves while full-period ICIR and turnover do not deteriorate.
recommendations.title: Target the empirically weakest regime and tail

recommendations.evidence: Ridge Rank IC 0.0483 nearly matches LightGBM 0.0499; only three sampled pairs exceed |rho|=0.90.
recommendations.experiment: Pre-register cluster representatives and compare frozen Ridge/LGBM on new folds.
recommendations.hypothesis: A smaller information set may match tree performance with less variance.
recommendations.success: No Rank IC loss beyond 0.003 and improved fold variance or turnover.
recommendations.title: Compress redundant features and benchmark Ridge

recommendations.evidence: Top20 proxy alpha turns negative at 20 bps; Top30/50 outperform Top20 in reused development evidence.
recommendations.experiment: Pre-register one buffered selection challenger on development-only data.
recommendations.hypothesis: Cutoff concentration and churn can erase weak ranking alpha.
recommendations.success: Higher net proxy alpha at 20–50 bps with no worse drawdown and sector concentration.
recommendations.title: Treat Top-K and turnover as joint design variables

recommendations.evidence: The fixed ensemble raises mean Rank IC to 0.0510 but lowers ICIR to 0.2556 versus LightGBM 0.2653.
recommendations.experiment: Freeze ensemble weights before a new validation period.
recommendations.hypothesis: Ridge can diversify LightGBM fold errors.
recommendations.success: Higher ICIR and worst-regime Rank IC without higher turnover.
recommendations.title: Test rank ensemble only if complementarity persists
